assumptions: Depth below core top increases with age (undisturbed core), so oldest=S05 (350 cm), youngest=S06 (5 cm).
Shannon computed on raw counts of all taxa, natural log, zero-count taxa ignored; sample totals differ but no rarefaction applied.
issues: Two taxa have all-zero counts in every sample; they do not affect Shannon.
Lab log remarks (archived residue, photographed, re-labelled) do not indicate count problems; processing batches differ but were not adjusted for.
summary: Computed Shannon H (ln) for youngest (shallowest) and oldest (deepest) samples; reported youngest minus oldest.
